Train to Massacre
2021-12-16T12:43:39+06:00 | Star Exclusive
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/train-massacre-2918931

June 13, 1971. It was midnight, when they began bringing hundreds of Marwari families to Saidpur Railway Station.

Under the waning moon, could they sense their impending fate? That a whole community would be wiped out from the locality? That they would cease to exist the next day?
